2607.02345.title: SkillFuzz: Fuzzing Skill Composition for Implicit Intents Discovery in Open Skill Marketplaces
2607.02345.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly automate software engineering tasks through reusable skills, natural-language instruction documents that guide planning and execution. Open skill marketplaces enable users to assemble agents by co-activating community-contributed skills, but marketplace operators typically audit skills in isolation. As a result, individually benign skills may interact to redirect an agent toward unintended objectives, which we term implicit intents. Detecting such intents is challenging because the effect emerges only through skill composition, execution environments are often unavailable at admission time, and the space of possible co-activations grows exponentially with marketplace size. In this paper, we formulate implicit-intent discovery as a fuzzing problem over skill compositions, where skill compositions are the unit under test, planning artifacts expose agent intent before execution, and deviations from a skill-free baseline serve as a differential oracle. Based on this formulation, we propose skillfuzz, the first execution-free testing approach that extracts structured skill contracts and uses contract-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search to prioritize potentially conflicting compositions. Across representative skill-marketplace workloads, skillfuzz discovers over 1,000 distinct implicit intents under a fixed query budget, confirms more than 80% of the highest-risk flagged compositions during execution-time validation, and identifies substantially more high-severity implicit intents than alternative search strategies while exploring only a fraction of the pairwise interaction space they require.
2607.02345.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）基礎的代理越來越多地通過可重用的技能、自然而然的指令文件來自動化軟體工程任務，這些文件指導規劃和執行。開放的技能市場使得用戶能夠通過共同激活社區貢獻的技能來組裝代理，但市場運營商通常是孤立地審核技能。因此，單獨無害的技能可能會互相作用，將代理引導至意想不到的目標，我們稱之為隱性意圖。檢測這些意圖是具有挑戰性的，因為其效果僅通過技能組合顯現，執行環境在入場時通常不可用，並且隨著市場規模的增長，可能的共同激活空間呈指數增長。在本文中，我們將隱性意圖發現公式化為一個針對技能組合的模糊測試問題，其中技能組合是測試單元，規劃工件在執行前暴露代理意圖，並且與無技能基準的偏差作為差異性預言機。基於這一公式化，我們提出了skillfuzz，這是第一種無執行測試方法，提取結構化技能合約並使用合約引導的蒙特卡羅樹搜索來優先考慮潛在衝突的組合。在具有代表性的技能市場工作負載中，skillfuzz在固定的查詢預算下發現了超過1,000個不同的隱性意圖，在執行時驗證過程中確認了超過80%最高風險標記的組合，並且在僅探索它們所需的部分成對互動空間的同時，識別出顯著更多的高嚴重性隱性意圖。
